gloss: half the number; half of the total

definitions.gloss: half the number; half of a group or total
definitions.explanation: Half of a countable set of people or things. Used in statistics, voting, and survey reports, where the related thresholds {過半数|かはんすう} (a majority) and {半数以上|はんすういじょう} (half or more) matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半数|はんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧だ。
examples.english: Half of the participants are women.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半数|はんすう}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: More than half of the employees work from home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、{回答者|かいとうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半数|はんすう}{近|ちか}く⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らなかった→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: According to the survey, close to half of the respondents did not know about this system.

notes:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Counts members of a set, so it is used with people, votes, and items — not with amounts like water or money, where ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧ is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半数|はんすう}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: half or more, more than half
- {半数|はんすう}{近|ちか}く: close to half
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧: a majority (more than half; the voting threshold)
- {半数|はんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to account for half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧: half — the everyday word, used for dividing a single thing (⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
- ⟦{二分|にぶん}→二分：30504_nibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: one half — the fraction, used in arithmetic and measurements
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧: majority — strictly more than half, the term used for resolutions and elections
